[THONG BAO KHAN_PHONG XU
LY NO] Kinh gui Ong/Ba
Toi la VO TRUNG
PHUC (MSNV: LOTFul1298), nhan
vien thoc Bo phan Phap che va Thu
hoi no. Do Ong/Ba lien tuc vi pham
cam ket va thieu thien chi hop tac,
ho so cua Ong/Ba da ghi nhan
danh sach (Loi dung chiem doat tin
dung co he thong). Yeu cau Ong/
Ba
co mat tai noi
cu tru truoc 09:00 ngay 9/9 de
phoi hop lam viec truc tiep voi cac
ben lien quan va dua ra phuong an
xu ly cuoi cung. Qua thoi han tren,
neu Ong/Ba van co tinh tron tranh
hoac ngat lien lac, chung toi se lap
tuc thuc hien cac bien phap cuong
che theo quy dinh, dong thoi ban
giao toan bo ho so sang Co quan
Chuc nang co tham quyen de dieu
tra hanh vi chiem dung tai san. Moi
he luy nghiem trong ve uy tin, diem
tin dung CIC, cac chi phi phat sinh
cung nhu anh huong tieu cuc den
gia dinh, ban be va nguoi than
xung quanh, phia Ong/Ba phai
hoan toan tu chiu trach nhiem
truoc phap luat. Tran trong!
+
